about: What an order's SAP identifiers mean to the apps, and how SAP's documents map onto the status a rep sees once an order is approved.
why: An approved order becomes a SAP Sales Order, and an A/R invoice raised against it is what says it has gone. The apps report those two facts and nothing in between. Decided 24 Sep 2026: production-order linking is out of the initial release. Under MRP a production order pools demand from many sales orders, SAP does not persist which order a pooled production order is for (verified: MRP-created POs carry no sales-order link, and the link table has no quantity), so any per-order production stage would be an allocation guess. The release reports only what SAP records as fact.

the_shape.custom_sap_sales_order: SAP's DocNum for the order. The rep's proof it reached the factory.
the_shape.custom_sap_sales_order_status: SAP's own words. Shown verbatim, never parsed, with the one exception under cancelled_is_the_one_mapped_status.
the_shape.custom_sap_invoice: SAP's A/R invoice DocNum. Set on the ORDER only once every line has been invoiced - see order_is_dispatched_only_when_every_line_is.
the_shape.custom_sap_synced_at: When the sync last reconciled this order.
the_shape.custom_sap_sync_error: Why the last push or pull failed.

the_shape_per_line.custom_sap_invoice: On Sales Order Item: the A/R invoice that carried THIS line.
the_shape_per_line.why: An order can be invoiced in parts. Only a per-line invoice can say which items have gone and which have not.

statuses.Not Started: SAP does not have the order yet. Approved-but-not-yet-pushed and not-yet-approved both read this way; the approval label, not this status, tells them apart.
statuses.Pushed to SAP: SAP has the order and it has not been invoiced.

rules.invoice_is_dispatch: An A/R invoice is what makes an order or a line Dispatched. Nothing else does. A delivery note is NOT dispatch in this release: the floor posts deliveries before invoicing, so an order that has been delivered but not invoiced reads Pushed to SAP until its invoice exists. Decided 24 Sep 2026.
rules.no_production_stage: There is no production stage between Pushed to SAP and Dispatched. custom_sap_production_order and custom_sap_production_stage are no longer written by the sync or read by either app. They still exist in ERPNext and may carry old values; nothing may act on them.
rules.no_sap_order_is_not_a_failure: An order with no SAP number has not been picked up yet. Only custom_sap_sync_error means something went wrong, and the two must never be shown the same way.
rules.edits_come_from_sap: Once approved, SAP is the record. A line the factory reduces or drops in SAP is reduced or removed in ERPNext by the sync's line reconcile, and both apps show the order as ERPNext then holds it. Neither app edits an approved order.
rules.stale_is_worth_saying: custom_sap_synced_at going quiet means SAP has moved and nobody here knows. Older than a day is worth showing.
rules.cancelled_is_the_one_mapped_status: custom_sap_sales_order_status is shown verbatim and never parsed, with exactly ONE exception: bost_Cancelled. A cancelled order is not a shade of progress, it is the order not happening, and an app that goes on calling it Approved tells a rep to expect goods nobody is making. bost_Cancelled is a SAP enum, so it is stable - and the sync folds SAP's separate Cancelled=tYES flag into the same value (Resolve-SoStatus), so one check covers both ways SAP says it. Found 18 Sep 2026: SAP order 399 had been cancelled and ERPNext had recorded it correctly for days, but nothing read it.
rules.cancelled_outranks_approval: Cancellation beats the approval status wherever the two are shown together, because it is the later fact and the terminal one.
rules.a_list_shows_sap_once_sap_has_it: An order list shows SAP's status once SAP has the order (or an invoice exists), and the stored in-app custom_production_status only before that - which is what every order placed before the floor moved to SAP on 11 Sep 2026 carries. The two are never mixed: an in-app Dispatched on an order SAP has not invoiced is not dispatch (invoice_is_dispatch). An order is complete - the tick, 'Order complete - dispatched' - exactly when this reads Dispatched. See order_progress. Added 24 Sep 2026, when both order lists were found still marking Dispatched from the in-app field.

line_rules.same_derivation: A line's status is derived exactly as an order's is. There is no second set of rules to drift.
line_rules.invoice_is_per_line: An invoice need not carry the whole order. A line is Dispatched only when THAT line was invoiced. Reading the order's invoice would mark an uninvoiced line Dispatched.
line_rules.a_line_is_pushed_when_its_order_is: A line has no SAP number of its own. It is Pushed to SAP when its order is.
line_rules.order_is_dispatched_only_when_every_line: The order rolls up to its least advanced line. An order is Dispatched only when every line has been invoiced; a partly-invoiced order is still Pushed to SAP. The sync writes the order-level custom_sap_invoice only at that point, because that field is what takes an order out of the sync's polling - writing it on the first partial invoice would stop the rest of the order ever being followed.

order_status.why: SAP has the order, nothing invoiced
Frappe reads an unset field back as the string null - that is not an invoice

line_status.why: order not in SAP yet, so neither is the line
order in SAP, this line not invoiced
an invoiced line is Dispatched even if the order's own SAP number is missing on this read

order_rolls_up_from_lines.why: every line invoiced - the order has gone
invoiced in parts across two invoices still counts once every line is covered
a partial invoice is NOT a dispatched order
not in SAP, no lines invoiced
an order with no lines falls back to its own invoice

order_progress.why: not in SAP yet: the stored in-app status, as before the changeover
an order finished in-app before the floor moved to SAP keeps its Dispatched
not in SAP and nothing stored
Frappe's string null is nothing stored
once SAP has it, SAP reports it - the stored status is not read
an in-app Dispatched is not dispatch - only an invoice is
an invoice is dispatch even if the SAP number is missing on this read

summary.why: invoiced - say which invoice and when
a stale production stage from before 24 Sep 2026 is never shown

cancelled_orders.why: SAP cancelled it, so the pill says so however the approval status reads
an open SAP order is not cancelled
closed is finished, not cancelled - the two must never be conflated
an order SAP has not taken yet cannot be cancelled
